how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form. You can download it from the JSBCCL website. You can also collect it from the JSBCCL office (3rd Floor, JSBCCL Building, Dhurwa, Ranchi) during office hours until 30 October 2026.
Fill in the form and your Bio-Data on A-4 size paper, strictly in the prescribed format.
Paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph on the form and sign below it.
Attach the relevant documents and list them under "List of enclosure". Sign the declaration.
Write the post title ("Assistant Manager (Electrical)") on the envelope.

Send it by registered or speed post so it reaches this address by 30 October 2026:Deputy General Manager (Administration), JSBCCL, 3rd Floor, JSBCCL Building, Project Bhawan Campus, Dhurwa, Ranchi – 834004
Keep a copy of the form you submitted.
SC, ST and OBC candidates: send a copy of your caste certificate with the form. At the interview, produce the certificate in the prescribed format, issued by an officer not below the rank of SDM.

If you work in a Government, Semi-Government or Public Sector body, or an Autonomous Body: apply through proper channel or produce an NOC. If you cannot get an NOC, you may give an undertaking at document verification that you will not claim service transfer benefits or pay protection. If selected, you must bring a relieving order when you join.

If your name is spelled differently in different certificates: bring a certificate from the SDM or an equivalent officer. Women who changed their surname after marriage need a marriage certificate and a notarised affidavit.
All original certificates must be produced at document verification. If you cannot produce them, you will be disqualified.
Incomplete applications are rejected outright. You cannot add information after you submit.
Keep your email ID active for at least one year. You cannot change it once you have entered it, and all correspondence is by email.
Canvassing of any kind disqualifies you. Legal disputes fall under the courts at Ranchi.
For queries, phone 0651-2446257/2446258/2446259 or email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About JSBCCL
content_sections.text: JSBCCL is a newly formed company fully owned by the Government of Jharkhand. Its registered office is at the Building Construction Department, Govt. of Jharkhand, Project Building, P.O.- Dhurwa, Ranchi-834004. It builds buildings and other infrastructure for state government departments, including Health, Medical Education & Family Welfare, Tourism, Higher Technical Education and School Education.

content_sections.heading: JSBCCL Assistant Manager (Electrical) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies may go up or down depending on what the company needs. content_sections.heading: JSBCCL Assistant Manager (Electrical) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 40 years as on 31 May 2026. The notice calls this date the "closing date". For candidates who have retired from State or Central Government or a PSU as Assistant Engineer (Electrical) on or before 31 May 2026, the limit is 64 years. Both age and post-qualification experience are counted as on 31 May 2026. You need a full-time degree in Electrical engineering, or an equivalent, from a Government-recognised university or institute, with 60% aggregate marks. Your degree counts from the date the result was declared or the mark sheet was issued, and no relaxation is given on this. If your degree is graded in CGPA or OGPA, give the equivalent percentage under your university's norms on the form. You must also produce a copy of those norms at document verification. You need 5 years of experience after your qualification, counted from the date you qualified. Under this heading the notice lists: External and internal electric works, HVAC, BMS works, data management and fire fighting systems in different types of buildings Designing and testing electrical systems and components Testing to make sure systems and components meet safety standards Troubleshooting and fixing technical problems while installing and maintaining electrical systems Documenting tests and the specifications of electrical components and systems Keeping up with new technologies, industry standards and regulations Proficiency in computers is preferred. The upper age limit applies to general category candidates. Age relaxation for SC, ST and OBC candidates follows Government guidelines. These candidates must send a copy of their caste certificate with the application form. Only Indian nationals may apply. If response is very high, JSBCCL may raise or lower the eligibility criteria. For the full post-wise eligibility, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted based on their academic qualification and experience. If response is very high, JSBCCL may shortlist using revised eligibility criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for a Personal Interview. The list and interview dates are published on the website, which the notice prints as www.jsbccljharkhand.gov.in . Candidates are also told by email. No other method of contact is used. The final selection depends on your interview performance and is subject to document verification. After that, the "Offer of Appointment" is issued. If a candidate is not suitable for the post they applied for, JSBCCL may offer a suitable post at a lower level.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The job is on contract for a maximum of three years. It can be extended for further years if your performance is satisfactory. You may be posted anywhere in the state, as the company requires. Your appointment depends on a satisfactory medical certificate from a Govt. Hospital, to the standard JSBCCL sets. Your caste and character certificates must also be verified by the authorities concerned. Applying does not give you any right to be appointed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JSBCCL Assistant Manager (Electrical) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form. You can download it from the JSBCCL website . You can also collect it from the JSBCCL office (3rd Floor, JSBCCL Building, Dhurwa, Ranchi) during office hours until 30 October 2026. Fill in the form and your Bio-Data on A-4 size paper, strictly in the prescribed format. Paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph on the form and sign below it. Attach the relevant documents and list them under "List of enclosure". Sign the declaration. Write the post title ("Assistant Manager (Electrical)") on the envelope. Send it by registered or speed post so it reaches this address by 30 October 2026:Deputy General Manager (Administration), JSBCCL, 3rd Floor, JSBCCL Building, Project Bhawan Campus, Dhurwa, Ranchi – 834004 Keep a copy of the form you submitted. SC, ST and OBC candidates: send a copy of your caste certificate with the form. At the interview, produce the certificate in the prescribed format, issued by an officer not below the rank of SDM. If you work in a Government, Semi-Government or Public Sector body, or an Autonomous Body: apply through proper channel or produce an NOC. If you cannot get an NOC, you may give an undertaking at document verification that you will not claim service transfer benefits or pay protection. If selected, you must bring a relieving order when you join. If your name is spelled differently in different certificates: bring a certificate from the SDM or an equivalent officer. Women who changed their surname after marriage need a marriage certificate and a notarised affidavit. All original certificates must be produced at document verification. If you cannot produce them, you will be disqualified. Incomplete applications are rejected outright. You cannot add information after you submit. Keep your email ID active for at least one year. You cannot change it once you have entered it, and all correspondence is by email. Canvassing of any kind disqualifies you. Legal disputes fall under the courts at Ranchi. For queries, phone 0651-2446257/2446258/2446259 or email [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. Can a general category candidate apply for this post?
faq.answer: The single vacancy is reserved for ST. The category table shows 0 posts for UR, SC, BC-I and BC-II.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply online?
faq.answer: No. You must post the filled-in form on A-4 paper by registered or speed post to the Deputy General Manager (Administration), JSBCCL, Dhurwa, Ranchi – 834004.

faq.question: Q3. Is the deadline the posting date or the receiving date?
faq.answer: It is the receiving date. The application must reach JSBCCL by 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write the title of the post you are applying for, "Assistant Manager (Electrical)".

faq.question: Q5. I retired as an Assistant Engineer (Electrical). Can I apply?
faq.answer: Yes, up to 64 years of age. You must have retired from State or Central Government or a PSU on or before 31 May 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: It runs for a maximum of three years. It can be extended for further years if your performance is satisfactory.

faq.question: Q7. What kind of experience counts?
faq.answer: You need 5 years of post-qualification experience. It should be in external and internal electric works, HVAC, BMS works, data management and fire fighting systems in buildings.

faq.question: Q8. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: JSBCCL publishes the list of shortlisted candidates and their interview dates on its website. It also tells candidates by email.

faq.question: Q9. I work in a PSU. Do I need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Apply through proper channel or produce an NOC. If you cannot get one, give an undertaking at document verification that you will not claim service transfer benefits or pay protection.
